title: Pyase ka Tadapna
body:
Tera zarben sookhi gardan or piyasy ka Tarapna
fatima ny kesy dekha hoga bety ka tarapna
(1) Pees kar chakiyan jis ko pala beti ny nabi ki.
Dasht mein haye usi Nazo'n kay Paly ka Tarapna
(2) Khak par Girna Alam ka Torna Bachon ke koozy
Mashk say Pani ka Behna Mashk Waly ka Tarapna
(3) Lagna Seeny mein Sina ka Wo kalejy ka Nikalna
Lash par Aaky jawan ke aik boordhy ka tarapna
(4) Maa ka Sehry sy lipat kar kha k gash girna zamee par
dorna ghoron ka haye Or Doolhy ka Tarapna.
(5) Manzar E Sham E Ghareeba Tha Qayamt ka Wo Manzar
Dekhti Thi Ma'a Pisar ke Jalty Jhooly ka Tarapna
(6) Bhool Payegi Na Zainab Ba'Riha nok e sina sy)
bawafa ke Sar ka Girna Or Pardy Ka Tarapna
(7) Hye Nadeem Or farishta kha ky zalim ke Tamachy
Cheekhna beti ka baba or lashy ka Tarapna.
